content: Awembiŋ ekŋengalen zet

Keyet kataŋ imbi awinmak in awine eksemindemti mambep. Âpme awin Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋgat wisat mti mamain beme in eksemindemti esemteŋ zetpiŋ mame awinaŋ ingalen mama mimi dolakŋaŋ ma kwetetepmaŋ ke ekti keŋin gilik zeme Kawawaŋ nâmkiŋpewep.

Imbi, ingalen mama mimi awinaŋ egoŋgoyelen ke sekŋinaŋgalen elimiak miak kaboŋ yek: ŋokŋin weyaŋ elimiakpemti maip ma kekek tosaŋaŋ temaŋ dolakŋaŋ penaŋ andomti maip ma saŋgum melakandu meluwaŋaŋ dolakŋaŋ munduŋti maip ekŋen ke segalen elimiak etaŋ.

Ingalen mama mimi ego egoŋaŋmak ke keŋinan awineyet gogot omba penaŋ mimiyet Kawawaŋaŋ bempeye. Elimiak miak ke ŋep ku endeleletgalen. Miak miak ke keŋ sewak palen mame Kawawaŋaŋ mama keboŋ keyet nâme pembenaŋ penaŋ mambein.
Nâmkiŋpepemak imbi tipman baen mamkwabien ekŋenaŋ miak miak sakam keboŋ ke mti mamkwatemienen webebeŋin Kawawaŋmagen tapme mamti awine eksemindewien.

Ekŋenmagengatnaŋ imbi kwep ŋen kwitnaŋ Sela egaŋ apmaŋ Abalaam ek eksempemti apmaŋgat nâme mopme, “Amobotnaŋŋ,” zeme maŋge. In Selayet nambaŋenenok besât mip beme in mama mimi dolakŋaŋ mti awineyet ku kiŋgabep.

An, in imbi ekŋenaŋ maeksem indeipnok imbiŋine eksemindewep. Enenogat it ilisakwep mama kanzizit mamayet Kawawaŋaŋ taolet mimideye. Keyepmti imbiŋine windeŋinpiŋ ke nâmtatiyepm indamukulem mbep. In kegok ku mbep beme dundunduŋinaŋgat setnaŋ bekek tabe.
Nin keŋ kwep bemti mambanup
Zet pigok ondekti zema delaŋ zek, in sambeyaŋ keŋin kwep bemti mambep. Ŋenaŋ ŋeniyet kembeŋ ŋenaŋ ŋeniyet kembeŋ mti noline nâmkiŋpepeen gogot mimindawep mti keŋ taolet mimindamti keŋin mtoti mambep.

Kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ bekanaŋ mimindame in kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ bekanaŋak ku gilik zem mimindawep. Ekŋenaŋ zet bekanaŋ diindome in zet bekanaŋak ku diindowep. Kawawaŋ dundum same mukulem mimindewe. In mama mimi keboŋ mti mamayet Kawawaŋaŋ maindakumtetiin. In kegok mti mame egaŋ keŋ taolet mimindawe.
Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen zet kapigok tazin,

content.text: “An ŋen nâmkiŋpepemak mama ke penaŋaŋmak bembeyelen nâin ma kan kataŋ oloŋen palen mamayelen nâin beme egaŋ dembusekŋaŋ damuŋ mti zet bekanaŋ ma zet dâsuki ŋen ku zewe.
Kegok mamayet nâmbe beme egaŋ bekanaŋ bamkumpemti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋ ke mbe mti keŋ sewakŋaŋ palen mama ke windeŋaŋbeŋ mbe.

Amobotnaŋ zikatnaŋ am mama teŋ penaŋ mamaip ekŋengalen mamaŋin maekmâtâzin. Amobotnaŋ egaŋ am mama teŋ penaŋ mamaip ekŋengalen dundundu nânâyet wak mambein ma am bekanaŋ mimi ekŋen indik kiŋgati mambamkumindein.” (Sam 34:12-16)

content: Sisipeŋpeŋ mimndame nâmisimtabanup
In kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋgat nâmtikŋaŋ mti mame an ŋenaŋ ku indawaleletgalen.
Yaŋgut mama mimi dolakŋaŋgapmti sisipeŋpeŋ palen mobep keyet oloŋen mbep.

content.text: “Kasayet sebet dindiŋ mti windeŋin ku kalube.” (Aizaya 8:12)

content: Ma ŋen kapigok keŋin kume kwaopme Kilais Amobotnaŋgat zapat penaŋ bemti tabep. Âpme in nukŋaŋ timti nâmisim matalip keyet yaŋaŋgat nânâyet indayaŋkwesime in zemâtâtindasâgât weyaŋ ekmâtâti sewak sewak kapigok diindowep, “Kawawaŋaŋ mandamukulem mme mamanup.”

In keŋin kwetetepmaŋ penaŋ weme am notnaŋaŋ ingat zet bamset zewep beme in Kilais mâpmaipgapmti am ekŋen zet mobotnaŋ mbep ekŋen ke ingalen mama mimi dolakŋaŋgat bekanaŋ manzewaŋ eksokbemti sakambuk mbep.
In kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋ mme sisipeŋpeŋ mimindawep ke Kawawaŋaŋ inmagen kegok sokbembeyet nâme kozin beme ŋep. Âk in yom mme keyet sindem indaip beme ke yominaŋgat dopmaŋ kogok nâmbep.

Kilais ek yom ŋen ku mge yaŋgut egaŋ bekanaŋgat dopmaŋ sek kwep gakime delaŋ zeye. Ek An teŋ penaŋaŋgut nin bekanaŋ mimi ningalen yomgapmti gakimti Kawawaŋmak tusumndeye. Ek am sekmak maŋge manepeme kume gakiye âpme Emetak Teŋaŋaŋ sekŋaŋ gakikiengatnan mme wage.
Âpme Kilaisiyelen Emetakŋaŋaŋ am gakiwien weŋin mka kaliŋan tabien ekŋenmagen meti Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ diindoye.

Ekŋen ke Noayaŋ waŋga maweyaŋkwapme Kawawaŋaŋ keŋ taoletnaŋgapmti ekŋenaŋ keŋ gilik zenzeyet damuŋ mamkwage yaŋgut ekŋenaŋ zetnaŋ kuluwien. Âpme animbi 8 etaŋ waŋgaen mowepme tuyaŋ mimindeme tu palen mme mekoti alik mambien.

Tuŋgwam kwati am sambe indapminzilime tu nimbien mme tu keyaŋ ŋegak Noamak nemunaniŋane ekŋengalen waŋga tuyaŋ belaŋ zem mmaŋge sepem kegok am Kilais nâmkiŋpeme tu manzulutindeip ekŋen ke Kawawaŋaŋ maaŋgalaŋindein. Tu manzululip keyaŋ sekgalen mubulup ke manzulupme kwawezin yek. Keyaŋ keŋinan Kawawaŋ manâmkiŋpeip keyet piliŋaŋ kogok manzulutindeip. Kawawaŋaŋ Zisas Kilais gakikiengatnan mme wage keeset maaŋgalaŋ indein.

Mti ikŋaŋ kululuŋen mogeyaŋ Kawawaŋgat betnaŋ penaneset windeyelen mundumen totazin. Ke tapme ensel windeŋinbeŋ sepem ikŋak ikŋak msat tâgâ tuŋgupman maip ekŋen Zisasiyet kandeŋan tatagat Kawawaŋaŋ nâmindeme talip.
